exam: 2023年12月 第2套 · 仔细阅读 P1
title: Having a rival can keep you committed to achieving your goal…

sents.en: Having a rival can keep you committed to achieving your goals and enhance your overall performance.
sents.cn: 拥有一个竞争对手，能让你坚守目标、提升整体表现。

sents.en: But before you go out and find an entrepreneur to outcompete, it's important to understand and avoid the traps that often come with rivalry.
sents.cn: 但在你出去寻找一位企业家并试图超越之前，重要的是认清并避开竞争常伴而来的陷阱。

sents.en: After all, competitive rivalry can also hinder effective decision-making and increase your willingness to take risks, behaviors that can ultimately hurt your venture's success.
sents.cn: 毕竟，竞争对抗也会妨碍有效决策、增加你冒险的意愿，而这些行为最终可能损害你创业的成功。

sents.en: Finding someone you're committed to outcompeting can be a great way to stay focused on your goals and push your venture to the next level.
sents.cn: 找到一位你一心想超越的人，是保持专注、推动事业更上一层楼的好办法。

sents.en: But when you're intently focused on outperforming your rivals, you may begin to develop a "win-at-all-costs" mentality that causes you to ignore how you achieve success.
sents.cn: 但当你一门心思要胜过对手时，可能会滋生一种“不择手段求胜”的心态，使你忽视成功是如何取得的。

sents.en: One group of researchers, for example, examined the link between rivalry and unethical behavior.
sents.cn: 例如，一组研究人员考察了竞争与不正当竞争行为之间的联系。

sents.en: They found that when people compete against their rivals, they are more willing to behave unethically to win.
sents.cn: 他们发现，当人们与对手竞争时，更愿意为了取胜而不择手段。

sents.en: But such behavior may stain your reputation and strain relationships important to your success.
sents.cn: 但这种行为可能玷污你的声誉，并损害对成功至关重要的关系。

sents.en: One way to avoid this trap is to stop and reflect on what's important.
sents.cn: 避开这一陷阱的办法之一是停下来，反思什么才重要。

sents.en: While outperforming your rivals may provide short-term benefits, the loss of your integrity will have long-term consequences.
sents.cn: 超越对手或许能带来短期利益，但丧失诚信将带来长远后果。

sents.en: One reason having a rival can enhance your venture's performance is that it creates a level of excitement that drives you to work harder.
sents.cn: 拥有对手能提升事业表现的一个原因是，它制造了一种兴奋感，驱使你更努力地工作。

sents.en: But this eagerness to win may also hurt your venture's success, particularly when it causes you to make impulsive, insensible decisions.
sents.cn: 但这种求胜的渴望也可能损害事业成功，尤其是当它让你做出冲动、不明智的决定时。

sents.en: But it's possible to avoid such costly mistakes by making a habit of engaging in critical thinking, such as considering opposing viewpoints and conducting cost-benefit analyses, especially for those decisions that are complex and can determine the future of your venture.
sents.cn: 不过，你可以通过养成批判性思考的习惯来避免这类代价高昂的错误，比如考虑对立观点、进行成本收益分析，对于那些复杂且能决定事业未来的决策尤其如此。

sents.en: The sense of eagerness that comes with having a rival can not only cause you to make poorer decisions, but it can also lead you to take greater risks that put your venture in peril.
sents.cn: 拥有对手带来的那种渴望，不仅可能让你做出更糟的决定，还可能使你承担更大的风险，将事业置于险境。

sents.en: One way you can overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry that stand to endanger your venture's success is to remain attentive to your emotional state and actively monitor how such feelings are affecting your decision-making.
sents.cn: 要克服这种可能危及事业成功的、由竞争诱发的风险效应，一个办法是留意自己的情绪状态，并主动监测这些感受如何影响你的决策。
